name: Odmit
description: A free, private to-do app — lists, sharing, tags, and recurring tasks. Installable as a PWA.

name: Asura
description: An idle tower defense game in sumi-e ink. Play the Asura, the water-dancing Daeva or the Sorcerer, who casts arcane bolts, flame, lightning and ice on mana, at the centre; ninja, samurai, oni and tengu come from every side. Installable app, plays offline.

name: Inkborne
description: A turn-based JRPG demo in sumi-e ink. Chain timed brushstrokes, fill the Vermilion Ink gauge and unfurl into a winged Inkwing form to stop the Blot unwriting the world. Installable app, plays offline.

name: HYOH
description: Hike Your Own Hike: an endless, procedurally generated walk through the Appalachian mountains. Blue ridgelines fading into haze, hardwood coves, hemlock hollows, creeks and valley mist, with a season switcher and synthesized wind, creeks and birdsong. Runs in the browser, no downloads.

name: aiNonomous Chat
description: An end-to-end encrypted, decentralized messaging PWA for chatting with friends and for tech support with anonymous guests. Built with Rust compiled to WebAssembly and Material 3, in light and dark. In planning and early development.
